_what: S357gf (24 Nov 2026): the job 35 headset checks (HEADSET_CHECKLIST_JOB35 + _JOB35D) in the order the visit meets them. tools/trial-report.mjs finds each one in a trial-watch log by its start token (regex over the timeline) and runs to the next item's start unless an end is given. lead = seconds before the start token (for a screen that opens before its ledger mark). machine = what the log can tell; eye = what only his eye can judge.

items.name: This week first
items.machine: the card opens at consent; time to Begin
items.eye: the This week card is over the board; Begin is easy to reach with the ray

items.name: Training and Lesson 1
items.eye: Lesson 1 lit, 2 and 3 veiled; Lambient's own cut readable before Your turn; no manual or verse lines

items.name: Heartwood, offered once
items.machine: the offer answered once (lamby guide:tvcall begun or dismissed); a tape played through or not; draw calls with the set out
items.eye: the set comes above the monitor, whole; nothing plays before ▶; a press on its body puts it back

items.name: Lessons 2 and 3
items.machine: places and family done; Training done 3 of 3
items.eye: the Wick marked in Áine's post; Lambient answers Maureen; you answer Annette; Orla's and Mam's messages each come alone

items.name: A memory from 2014
items.machine: time from the day's end to her Notes
items.eye: a small card, no text box, no Install; her story as published, then her own words struck through

items.name: Her Notes, in their column
items.machine: Notes open; nothing else logged over them
items.eye: the Notes in the phone's column beside the page, no window over another; one line types; nothing speaks

items.name: Bea's news: column, whole lines, pace, scroll
items.machine: seconds the news holds; fps and draw calls
items.eye: the group stays in its column; no line cut; each message readable before the next; ▲ Earlier messages and ▼ New messages work by the ray; Bea's card and 'Malta · Act LV of 2016 · passed 5 December' readable; nothing offered for you to say

items.name: The campaign kit
items.eye: 'GracePlatform chose your story.'; the kit and the take-down line read clearly

items.name: The removal, seen
items.eye: the outline slow and calm; 'removing…', the grey and the fold each visible, inside the column

items.name: Outnumbered, your forward, the ending
items.machine: the forward pressed or not; seconds the thread holds before the update
items.eye: 'Review could not keep up.'; the ray reaches '↪ Forward the link'; does 2016's ending land?

items.name: The update: changelog and terms
items.machine: Remind me later count; pages read
items.eye: the changelog is about Vera; each terms page a few lines; 'Next page' easy to press; no 'Phone disconnected' box

items.name: The flight
items.machine: lowest fps and peak draw calls during the flight (budget 75)
items.eye: the turn starts as you rise, toward the room, not the wall; no fade, no cut; comfortable?; no white hole; the space still opens and the colour changes

items.name: 2026 (not on this checklist: your remarks only)
items.eye: anything you say here is kept for the next round

items.name: Her line stays
items.eye: the monitor stays in front of you, goes dark with the room, never slides to the side

items.name: The stars come down; nothing behind you
items.machine: seat height unchanged; head turns all the way round (camera yaw)
items.eye: the stars settle round you; every label reads from the seat; turning round, only stars

items.name: The cards stay put
items.eye: each next card in the same place; nothing drawn over it

items.name: The panels, back to them, the pointer on white, Start again
items.machine: Start again reached (a new start in the log)
items.eye: panels in front at eye level; Back to the panels works; the ray's end and ring visible on the white 2016 site and the Lexicon; Start again restarts; nothing names Meridian
